guidelines.detail: same as LRN-006 (The description places several preparation activities before the later audit, and the records show a parallel split and flows to those activities. This guideline is essentially the same as learned guideline LRN-006.)

same as LRN-017 (The description makes meeting the criteria a condition for awarding certification, while the generated label adds that condition to the activity label (P4, S5). LRN-017 already covers keeping associated criteria and later outcomes out of activity labels unless they define the activity.)

same as LRN-016 (The description says the process begins when a company schedules an audit. The reference models this as a task following the start event, while the generated model instead has a start event representing the scheduling action. This guideline is already covered by learned guideline LRN-016.)

same as LRN-016 (The description states that the company schedules the audit as the initiating action. The generated start event represents that action, while the reference has a separate scheduling task and start event. This supports modeling the action after a start event, consistent with learned guideline LRN-016.)

refines FID-01 (The description says the process concludes with issuing official documents, but the generated model represents that work as an end event without a counterpart in the reference. FID-01 calls for modeling distinct activities; this guideline clarifies how to represent concrete work that produces an outcome before the process ends.)

refines FID-02 (The description separately states that auditors review processes and identify gaps or issues, while the reference includes a distinct audit task that is absent from the generated model. This refines the guidance to preserve separately described actions by clarifying how to model a review and its findings. rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names multiple required activities without specifying their order and states that a later outcome depends on all of them: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them before that outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description lists several distinct activities that must be completed before a later phase, without specifying an order or dependency among them.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity together with criteria, optional supporting actions, or a later outcome associated with it: Label the BPMN task with a concise verb-object phrase for the activity itself. Keep associated criteria, alternatives, and subsequent outcomes out of the label unless they define the activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity together with criteria or a subsequent outcome associated with it

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies work performed by a participant as the first step of the process: Model that work as an activity after a start event and before the subsequent activity; do not represent the work itself as the start event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies an action performed by a participant as the first step of the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a concrete action is performed to produce or deliver an outcome before the process reaches its stated terminal outcome: model the concrete work as a task and then use an end event for the terminal outcome
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a concrete action is performed to produce or deliver an outcome before the process reaches its stated terminal outcome

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a review is performed and separately identifies findings from that review: Model the review and the identification of findings as distinct BPMN tasks when they are described as separate activities.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a review is performed and separately identifies findings from that review
